Read .agents/skills/photoreal-render/SKILL.md, docs/decisions/ADR-0013-presentation-renders.md and the Presentation rendering rows of docs/LEARNINGS.md. Start from out/photoreal/*.qa.json, then look at every image at full size. For each defect, report: what is visible, the physical or pipeline root cause (walk the skill's diagnosis order; do not propose more samples, stronger lights or new textures before a structural cause is ruled out), the fix, and the guard that would catch it next time (a render_qa check, a verify.py lint or a script post-condition). Say whether an existing guard should have caught it and why it did not. Never retouch images, never change design geometry or photometry to make a render look better, and keep presentation assumptions labelled. Return findings ranked by how much they break realism.
